features.name: Olympian Respins
features.description: Premium wins stick while the rest respins.

review:
Invictus is a Roman arena slot with two systems. Pantheon Multipliers sit on both sides of the grid, and any win starting from a row gets that row's multiplier. The left-side values are always shown, while the right-side ones are only revealed when a five-symbol win crosses the whole grid.

Olympian Respins hold any win made of premium symbols or wilds in place and respin the rest, continuing as long as those wins keep growing. The Temple of Jupiter bonus improves the multiplier odds, and the cap is 10,000x. Strategic-looking, with gladiatorial art.
